subject: Error: modification indices with ordinal variable in model

messages.author: ee65f9feb643484e
messages.subject: Error: modification indices with ordinal variable in model
parts:
Dear Yves and lavaan group,

I get an error when I try to get modification indices for a model containing an ordinal variable. Is this expected?

An example is shown below. I'm using lavaan 0.5-18.

Thanks,
Mark

####################################################################################

set.seed(1)

n <- 1000  # sample size

F1 <- rnorm(n)  # latent variable

beta <- 0.6
F2 <- beta*F1 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - beta^2))  # latent variable

# Indicator loadings
L1 <- 0.7
L2 <- 0.6
L3 <- 0.5
L4 <- 0.7
L5 <- 0.6
L6 <- 0.5

th1 <- 0.5  # threshold for binary variable x1

d <- data.frame(x1 = ifelse(L1*F1 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L1^2)) > th1, 1, 0),
                x2 = L2*F1 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L2^2)),
                x3 = L3*F1 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L3^2)),
                x4 = L4*F2 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L4^2)),
                x5 = L5*F2 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L5^2)),
                x6 = L6*F2 + rnorm(n, 0, sqrt(1 - L6^2)))

mod1 <- '
F1 =~ x1 + x2 + x3
F2 =~ x4 + x5 + x6
F2 ~ F1
'

sem1 <- sem(mod1, data=d, ordered="x1")

> modificationIndices(sem1)
Error in lav_partable_full(object@ParTable, free = TRUE, start = TRUE,  : 
  object 'eqs.y' not found
